lines.en: The blind beast shuffles toward sound
I crush the blocks underfoot
Every step gives me away
I shoulder through the rock wall
My claws carve a long groove
I follow the trail of your steps
Rubble collapses behind me
I lower my head to feel the ground
Obsidian stops me cold
I go around the bedrock and walk on
My huge shadow sweeps the forest
I push whole trees aside
My steps make dead leaves jump
I close in on the light, step by step
I do not look, I only listen
The wall falls, and I pass through
I tilt my head to the wind
Echoes fill the dark for me
I freeze and wait for a sound
A low hum rolls in my throat
My blind eyes face nothing
I press my ear to the ground
My breathing comes heavy
I am waiting for one mistake
A falling pebble sounds so loud
I run my tongue over my teeth
Silence is a map to me
I cannot see you, but I hear you
Standing still will not save you
Your breathing is far too loud

lines.zh: 我歪着头记下你的位置
lines.en: I tip my head and note your place
My black eyes hold no image of you
You stepped on a dry branch

lines.zh: 我听得见你手里的东西
lines.en: I hear what you hold in your hand
Your heartbeat skipped one beat
Blind, but I am not deaf
I grin in your direction
I roar from the pain

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的步伐
lines.en: That broke my stride
I back off a step and hold
The wound burns
I shake my head to throw off the pain
I am angrier than before
A crack runs through my shell
I can still hear you
Do not think this is ending
I can take it, you cannot
That sound is not meat
Waving food at me changes nothing
I want something living that screams
Throw me a villager and I will turn
Ten beasts, for your one life

lines.zh: 你身上没有我要的味道
lines.en: You do not smell like my meal
I sniff at your hand
Quiet, I am listening elsewhere
Does your food make any sound
I want to hear it struggle
You ran into my arms
I hold you like a wall
You are thrown back several steps
My hide is all hard shell
The impact carries far
You hit my knee
I did not even sway
You hear your own bones knock
I brush you aside
I have memorized that sound
My kin are calling far off
That scream is a mating call
I walk toward my own kind
There are other blind ones here
We know each other by our roars
I send a low call down the valley
Two sets of steps shake deeper
She is waiting in the dark too
Our children will be larger
Two long howls merge into one

lines.zh: 我捡起一块还热的石头
lines.en: I pick up a stone still warm
This thing makes a sound
I push the shard into my mouth
I lift a whole trunk
I take up a fallen bone
It crumbles in my claw
I squeeze and listen to it split
This one I keep for my teeth
I throw it far to hear it land
My claws collect hard things
Something moved and made noise
You stamped your foot once
That sound, I found you
I snap my head toward you
Vibration climbs through the ground
Someone is running
Your door made far too much noise
I hear metal knock metal
The prey announced its position
My teeth clamp together
It is right over there
You can no longer hide
You are edging left
I heard that again
Your breathing quickens
I take the path apart block by block
That wall will not hold you
I turn with the echo
You broke glass underfoot
Every sound pulls you closer
I smell the salt in your sweat
You jumped once, I heard it
This forest hides no one
I push the trees aside one by one
You hold your breath too late
I am right behind you
My huge claw slams down
One swipe sends you flying
My fangs sink into your shoulder
My tail sweeps a wide arc
I ram you into the wall
This blow carries a whole stone
I press you into the dirt
Your taste fills my teeth
I strike and split the ground
You hear your armor buckle
A scream tears the night open
That call drags me into being
The ground splits before I climb out
A mountain rises out of the dark
The scream still echoes and I am here
My outline forms among the trees
The blocks beneath me give way
Blind eyes open in the night

lines.zh: 我循着第一声呼吸落地
lines.en: I land on the first breath I hear
This place will be quiet for a long time

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住整片林子
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole grove
The scream ends, I remain
The fire singes my hide

lines.zh: 摔下来时我砸出一个坑
lines.en: I hit the ground and leave a crater

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我听不见了
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I lose all sound
The blast leaves my ears ringing
An arrow sticks in my shell
Magic seeps into my bones
Hunger makes my steps unsteady

lines.zh: 雷击顺着我的背脊炸开
lines.en: Lightning bursts along my spine
Falling, even the echo is gone
